channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Malaysia screens travellers from India, Bangladesh for Nipah virus
item.description: Health Ministry conducts targeted screening at all entry points for travellers from high-risk countries like India and Bangladesh to detect Nipah virus

item.title: Penang Chinese New Year open house set for Feb 17 at SPICE Arena
item.description: Penang's state-level Chinese New Year open house will be held on Feb 17 at SPICE Arena, featuring cultural performances and traditional food

item.title: Car slams into entrance of New York City synagogue, no injuries reported
item.description: Police investigate possible hate crime after car crashes into Chabad Lubavitch HQ in New York; no injuries reported, driver arrested

item.title: Climate change ‘significantly’ worsened southern Africa floods: study
item.description: Climate change intensified deadly floods in southern Africa as some areas saw a year’s rainfall in just 10 days, scientists say.

item.title: KLIA solar farm project to cut 35,000 tonnes of CO2 annually
item.description: A new solar farm and battery system at KLIA will generate 46 GWh of green power yearly, supporting Malaysia's 70% renewable energy target by 2050

item.title: KLIA solar farm to cut airport carbon emissions by 30% by 2027
item.description: A new solar farm and battery system at KLIA Aeropolis is projected to reduce the airport's carbon emissions by 30% once fully operational in 2027

item.title: Phan Huy: The fashion prodigy putting Vietnam on the map
item.description: Vietnamese designer Phan Huy makes history as the youngest and first from Vietnam to show at Paris Haute Couture Week.

item.title: 331 GISBH money laundering cases consolidated before single judge
item.description: 331 money laundering charges involving over RM38.1 million against former GISBH CEO and three accountants will be heard by one judge

item.title: Malaysia urged to accelerate corporate adoption of innovation
item.description: Science minister says corporations must lead in adopting startup technologies to boost national competitiveness and avoid innovation stagnation

item.title: Police deploy 1,520 personnel for Thaipusam security and traffic in Batu Caves
item.description: Selangor police mobilise 1,520 officers for Thaipusam festival, closing seven roads in stages and warning against unauthorised drone use
